quote: Revenue for fiscal year 2026 was $215.9 billion, up 65% from a year ago. Data Center revenue for fiscal year 2026 was up 68% from a year ago.
text: NVIDIA reported fiscal-year 2026 revenue of $215.9 billion, up 65%, while Data Center revenue was up 68%.

quote: Gaming revenue for fiscal year 2026 was up 41% from a year ago, driven by strong Blackwell demand.
text: NVIDIA said Gaming revenue for fiscal year 2026 was up 41%, driven by Blackwell demand.
For fiscal 2026, Compute & Networking revenue was $193,479 million and Graphics revenue was $22,459 million.
For fiscal 2026, Compute & Networking segment operating income was $130,141 million and Graphics segment operating income was $9,156 million.

quote: At the foundation of the NVIDIA accelerated computing platform are our GPUs, which excel at parallel workloads such as the training and inferencing of neural networks.
text: NVIDIA describes its GPUs as the foundation of its accelerated-computing platform for parallel workloads including neural-network training and inference.

quote: While our approach starts with powerful chips, what makes it a full-stack computing platform is our large body of software, including the CUDA development platform, the CUDA-X collection of acceleration libraries, AI models and training data sets, APIs, SDKs, and domain-specific application frameworks.
text: NVIDIA describes its full-stack computing platform as combining chips with CUDA, CUDA-X libraries, AI models and training datasets, APIs, SDKs, and application frameworks.

quote: Gross margins decreased to 71.1% in fiscal year 2026 from 75.0% in fiscal year 2025 as our business model transitioned from offering Hopper HGX systems to Blackwell full-scale datacenter solutions and a $4.5 billion charge associated with H20 excess inventory and purchase obligations in the first quarter of fiscal year 2026.
text: NVIDIA's gross margin decreased to 71.1% in fiscal 2026 from 75.0% in fiscal 2025; the company cited its transition to Blackwell full-scale data-center solutions and a $4.5 billion H20-related charge.
NVIDIA reported fiscal-2026 revenue by direct-customer headquarters location of $149,617 million in the United States, $42,345 million in Taiwan, and $19,677 million in China including Hong Kong.

quote: increasing supply commitments from $ 119 billion last quarter to $ 279 billion as of July 26, 2026.
text: NVIDIA said its supply commitments increased from $119 billion in the prior quarter to $279 billion as of July 26, 2026.

quote: in certain instances, these agreements may be cancelable, rescheduled, or adjustable for our business needs prior to placing firm orders. Changes to these agreements may result in additional costs.
text: NVIDIA disclosed that some supplier agreements may be canceled, rescheduled, or adjusted before firm orders, and that changes may result in additional costs.

text: NVIDIA reported Q2 fiscal-2027 revenue of $96,221 million, up 106% year over year, and gross margin of 75.0%.

quote: Revenue is expected to be $108.0 billion, plus or minus 2%. NVIDIA is not assuming any Data Center compute revenue from China in its outlook.
text: NVIDIA forecast Q3 fiscal-2027 revenue of $108.0 billion, plus or minus 2%, and said its outlook assumed no Data Center compute revenue from China.
caveat: This is management guidance, not a reported result; actual revenue may differ.

quote: Record quarterly Data Center revenue of $62.3 billion, up 22% from Q3 and up 75% from a year ago
text: NVIDIA announced Q4 fiscal-2026 Data Center revenue of $62.3 billion, up 75% year over year.

quote: CUDA is a parallel computing platform and programming model developed by NVIDIA that enables dramatic increases in computing performance by harnessing the power of the GPU.
text: The CUDA Programming Guide describes CUDA as a parallel-computing platform and programming model developed by NVIDIA that uses GPU processing power.
